subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 6th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: 6th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: drow scout identification
fact: The drow scout is Nym, from Velkynvelve, whose gait is familiar to Daz.
source_quote: Drow. Zalthir remembers the particular gait of one of the Drow soldiers, Nym

subject: monk story reference
fact: Korrh Erann was part of a group pursued for days by Drow; he chose to run and was the only survivor.
source_quote: The monk, Korrh Erann, had been part of a group pursued for days. Some of their group hoped that killing the scouts would slow the Drow down. Korrh insisted that this was a dangerous gamble and chose to run. He was the only survivor.

subject: tunnel selection
fact: Zalthir chooses the tunnel veering left as a hiding spot.
source_quote: He sees a tunnel and chooses the one veering left.

subject: tremor source
fact: Grygum’s Thaumaturgy caused the tremor that misled Nym into thinking the cave was collapsing.
source_quote: What Nym didn’t know was that Grygum’s Thaumaturgy was the source of the tremor.

subject: Faerzress effect
fact: The Faerzress, previously inert, now seems to act as a poison to Shuushar, though its only known magical power is to prevent teleportation.
source_quote: Shuushar mutters, “That was odd. It was the first time I had felt so strange. The Faerzress was just a light, but now it seems to be a poison.” Jim Jar mutters, “The Faerzress has never affected a living thing. Its only magical power is to prevent teleportation spells.”

subject: tunnel navigation philosophy
fact: The Underdark is not flat; tunnels twist, turn, and change; enemies can appear far away or suddenly in front; movement is key, and shortcuts must be avoided.
source_quote: Sarith mutters, “Overbriters that cannot fly are the easiest prey in the Underdark.” He then explains, “The Underdark is not flat. And the tunnels don’t move in a straight line. They twist, and they turn. Worse, the tunnel system is constantly changing. And so an enemy can appear far away, only to appear in front of you. What’s important is that we move. And we hope no tunnel gives them a shortcut to find us.”

subject: track covering strategy
fact: The dwarf was taught to cover tracks in the Underdark; Eldeth is assigned to hide the group’s trail.
source_quote: The dwarf whispers, “I was taught to cover our tracks in the Underdark.” ... Eldeth, it’s up to you to hide us.

subject: rations call
fact: Sarith shouts, “Rations!” after the creature’s defeat.
source_quote: Sarith shouts, “Rations!”

subject: Stool’s rapport spores
fact: Stool releases rapport spores, enabling mind-link communication with the group.
source_quote: Stool jumps on and releases his rapport spores. ... Using the mind link created by Stool, he lets the group know.

subject: betting on food
fact: Jim Jar proposes a bet that no one will find food because Zalthir insisted on running.
source_quote: Jim Jar mutters, “I was going to make a bet that I was going to find food, and you guys weren’t. But the silent one,” and he points at Zalthir,” wanted us to run. So nobody is going to find food.” He pauses, “Wanna bet?”

subject: drow scout retreat
fact: Nym, hearing a thump and feeling a tremor, assumes the cave is collapsing and leaves without evidence of the prisoners.
source_quote: Nym draws his weapon. He looks around. Then, he feels a tremor. Worried that this cave will collapse and seeing no evidence of the prisoners, he turns to leave.

subject: drow tunnel disagreement
fact: Nym mutters, “I told you it was the other tunnel,” indicating internal conflict among the Drow scouts.
source_quote: As they leave, Nym mutters, “I told you it was the other tunnel.”

subject: Grygum’s guidance
fact: Grygum identifies the correct tunnel, prompting Sathir to rush forward despite annoyance.
source_quote: Grygum shouts, “Is this what you are looking for?” Sathir mutters, “Yes, I saw that.” He looks annoyed, “I didn’t need your help. But it’s good that you can help.”

subject: water scarcity warning
fact: Sathir warns the group they have no water and must go slow tomorrow to find some.
source_quote: Sathir explains, “We did well to put some distance. But we have no water. And if we don’t find some soon, things will get unpleasant. Tomorrow, we must go slow.
